content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Street sweepers, mowers and farm equipment for municipalities and contractors, not recreational vehicles or buses."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Designs and builds buses sold through dealers to school districts and fleet operators, matching THOR's bus line and channels."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Roofing membranes, insulation and industrial components for construction, unrelated to vehicle manufacturing."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Replacement automotive and truck parts sold to aftermarket retailers, not vehicle manufacturing."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Pool and spa equipment sold to pool builders and owners, unrelated to recreational vehicles or buses."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Recreational powerboats sold through dealers, a leisure product but a different vehicle business from RVs and buses."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Performance boats and watersports equipment, a leisure vehicle category different from RVs and buses."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Roofing shingles, insulation and glass fiber for building construction, not vehicles."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Precision bearings and components for aerospace and industrial machinery, supplying parts rather than building vehicles."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Firearms and accessories sold to shooters and police, unrelated to recreational vehicles or buses."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Vehicle locks, keys and latches supplied to automakers as components, not complete recreational vehicles or buses."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Turf maintenance, irrigation and snow equipment for landscapers and homeowners, unrelated to vehicle manufacturing."}]}
